entries.text: I’m Gokul’s AI guide. Product and engineering architect with 10+ years shipping products from 0→1. From resource-efficient on-device models to multi-agent platforms, I build and lead teams delivering agent architectures, durable pipelines and computer vision into production.

2016–2019: Flytta — Co-founder & CTO, working on edge ml.
2020–2021: Pramati — Labs Senior Engineer, working on deep learning.
2021–2023: Accenture Labs — Product & Platform Specialist, working on ml systems.
2023–2025: Plena Data Inc. — Head of Engineering, working on multi-agent systems.
2025–present: LaunchAI — Product, working on agent architecture.

At Plena Data, I architected a desktop sales platform with five specialized agents for research, enrichment and outreach. At LaunchAI, my work covers vision-first desktop agents, dynamic context, MCP, tool calling, guardrails and evaluation.

My work grew from YOLOv2 and LSTM models at Flytta to LEGAL-BERT, knowledge graphs and audio-visual deep learning at Pramati. At Accenture Labs, I worked on RAG, transformers, document intelligence and physics-informed ML. Today, I work on agents and small-model evaluation at LaunchAI.
I co-founded Flytta, where the company grew to 22 people. At Plena Data, I led 13 engineers delivering AI products from 0 to 1. Today, I own product direction at LaunchAI.

Flytta · Co-founder & CTO (2016–2019).

Co-founded a mobility company and built its technology, from enterprise relocation platforms to machine learning running on mobile devices and Raspberry Pi. Shipped YOLOv2 object detection with transfer learning and on-device inference for instant mobile cost estimation, replacing manual quotation visits.
Shipped YOLOv2 object detection with transfer learning and on-device inference for instant mobile cost estimation, replacing manual quotation visits.
Built LSTM anomaly detection on Raspberry Pi sensor streams for real-time edge inference and cargo damage prevention.
Built corporate portals, a vendor management system and Android/iOS apps. Scaled the company to 22 people and co-owned finance and operations.

Pramati · Labs Senior Engineer (2020–2021).

Connected language models, knowledge graphs and audio-visual deep learning while engineering automated compliance pipelines. Engineered compliance extraction across PDF, web, Excel, image and XML sources for all US states, using SciPy, Selenium and Airflow orchestration.
Engineered compliance extraction across PDF, web, Excel, image and XML sources for all US states, using SciPy, Selenium and Airflow orchestration.
Evaluated LEGAL-BERT for contract review and built a Neo4j knowledge graph for private-equity competitive intelligence with automated entity linking.
Developed an audio-visual deep learning framework for real-time speech synthesis and video generation driven by 3D face models and one-shot learning.

Accenture Labs · Product & Platform Specialist (2021–2023).

Owned technical direction and architecture across physics-informed ML, document intelligence, language systems and large-scale data pipelines. Owned technical direction for LEO satellite orbit prediction using physics-informed ML and synthetic data generation pipelines.
Owned technical direction for LEO satellite orbit prediction using physics-informed ML and synthetic data generation pipelines.
Led entity resolution and sentiment-analysis R&D: RAG pipelines, deep learning entity matching and aspect-based sentiment with HuggingFace transformers.
Architected document intelligence spanning OCR, NER, dewarping and summarization. Built Tamr connectors handling terabytes across sources and a product testing framework.

Plena Data Inc. · Head of Engineering (2023–2025).

Led 13 engineers shipping AI product verticals from 0→1, including a desktop sales platform and self-serve multi-agent workflows. Architected a desktop sales platform with five specialized agents using existing user sessions for lead research, AI-assisted enrichment and multi-channel outreach.
Architected a desktop sales platform with five specialized agents using existing user sessions for lead research, AI-assisted enrichment and multi-channel outreach.
Built drag-and-drop, self-serve multi-agent workflows with context engineering for task continuity. Improved sales by 25% for non-standard lead generation.
The agentic self-serve platform directly drove the company’s acquisition. Led post-acquisition integration and cloud platform migration.

LaunchAI · Product (2025–present).

Own product direction for enterprise desktop process automation, building vision-first RPA and agentic workflows for accounts payable and ERP-connected finance. Architected deterministic agent workflows with dynamic context switching, guardrails and prompt-management templates, including organization-wide standards for MCP servers and tool and function calling.

Architected deterministic agent workflows with dynamic context switching, guardrails and prompt-management templates, including organization-wide standards for MCP servers and tool and function calling.
Used modular agent architectures with hot-swappable model components to bring time to market from 3 months to 2 weeks and save $15K per month per customer.
Defined evaluation strategy for small vision-language and language models, including fine-tuning, benchmarking, agent tracing and LLM observability.

Agentend.ai — An open-source framework for replacing existing backend architecture.

Field hockey has been a big part of my life, including state and national competitions.
I’ve helped organize PyCon India, Hyderabad Python User Group and AI Saturdays. I enjoy connecting with other people who like to build and learn.
I’ve played field hockey at state and national competitions, and helped organize PyCon India, Hyderabad Python User Group, AI Saturdays.
Studied Computer Science at Hindustan University.
I’m based in Chennai, India.
You can reach me at gokul.0369@gmail.com, find me on LinkedIn as gok03, or explore my work on GitHub as gok03.
Small Models, Big Impact is my 2026 talk at PyConf Hyderabad, about the possibilities of small language models. The slides and resources are available here.
